snippet.title: Tete's Atelier: Patches // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3484990/Tetes_Atelier_Patches/

Tete received a patch customization machine from her grandmother and now transforms each piece of clothing into something special! Unleash your creativity, create unique pieces, and sell them in your in-game store.

Developed by 
Game Controll Studio aka @gamecontrollstudio5108
